name: video-skills
description: Skills for producing videos, distilled from the lessons of past work: design and visuals, sound and voiceover, 3D animation, interface recording, rendering and optimization — plus an optional pre-production mode (brief, references, style frames, beat sheet, test shot) and a map of the code-driven video stack (backbones, motion, hand-drawn looks, particles, shaders, post-processing, 3D, Blender, physics, TTS, beat grids, music videos, character acting) with review and QA scripts.
